name: Feather
dof_breakdown: two 7-DoF arms (1 m reach), torso lift with 600 mm vertical travel, omnidirectional wheeled base
price_note: promotional launch price; listed at $32,990. Payload is rated per arm (6.8 kg peak)
summary: A wheeled, dual-arm humanoid sold to developers who bring their own AI models through Feather's controls and SDK. It launched on 24 September 2026 with US$7.6M in funding led by Gradient, after about a year of customer field testing, and runs about 10 hours on two hot-swappable batteries.

sources.title: Feather launches a $30,000 wheeled humanoid for developers — Humanoids Daily
